# `arrays_overlap`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns true if a1 contains at least a non-null element present also in a2. If the arrays have no common element and they are both non-empty and either of them contains a null element null is returned, false otherwise.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
arrays_overlap(a1, a2)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- arrays_overlap, example 1
> SELECT arrays_overlap(array(1, 2, 3), array(3, 4, 5));
true
```
